species.sourceSummary: mapZebrain manifest metadata with local STL paths materialized for frontend lookup.
catalogNotes: The staged manifest has 265 regions total and 259 regions with STL paths.

licenseCaveat: Verify mapZebrain reuse terms and citation requirements before redistributing downloaded STLs or derived GLB assets.

meshNamingConvention.description: Downloaded STL file stems from manifest local_file become Blender object names, matching meshName exactly, for example 916_preoptic_area. Regions without STL paths have no meshName.

groupNormalization.description: Blank source CSV groups are normalized to frontend group Ungrouped. Source group text is preserved in sourceGroup.

duplicateLabelPolicy: Duplicate biological labels from source atlases are preserved. Use structureId or meshName, not label alone, as region identity.
